title: Tomorrow, imagined yesterday
subject: Nakagin Capsule Tower
context: What if a building could change as its inhabitants did? Architect Kisho Kurokawa explored that idea through prefabricated capsules attached to two central towers. Completed in Tokyo in 1972, the building became an enduring symbol of the Metabolist movement. It was dismantled in 2022; restored capsules survive in museum collections.

MoMA describes the capsules as attached to two concrete-and-steel cores; 'two central towers' is kept from the draft.
